details.report: Committed 1f01e9cae81fd4e212b987db958a844f469cae32. Removed Doctor Soul wording acceptance tests; Doctor semantics remain enforced through typed output/runtime behavior and the isolated compliance audit. Made doctorOutputSchema/TypeBox the sole structural validator, moved whitespace nonblank enforcement into the schema, and retained only catalog/evidence/StatsLine/population/disposition joins afterward. Added schema-before-context drift coverage. Regenerated dist and package artifact. Verified focused Doctor/package tests, typecheck, isolated-HOME full suite (347 pass, 5 skipped), packed/cold-install lifecycle coverage, npm pack dry-run and actual pack, and git diff check. No findings were left unadopted.
